concepts.name: Five-year stack, one live gate
concepts.metaphor: Five suspended funding wafers with only the first illuminated and a blank annual report controlling the path upward.
concepts.half_second_read: One funded layer is real and the later layers sit behind review.

concepts.name: Budget manifold
concepts.metaphor: One federal inlet divides into annual channels feeding a multi-institution research network.
concepts.half_second_read: Funding travels through a controlled annual valve.

concepts.name: Center mobile
concepts.metaphor: Six research rooms hang from one budget block while evidence returns through a review lens.
concepts.half_second_read: The lead institution controls the network and reports back through one gate.

eval_history.observation: The finished cover cleanly shows five physical layers, one funded gold layer, four dim future layers, and a blank report held in the only warm aperture. The two-line headline remains legible at thumbnail size without hiding the annual gate. No stray text, logos, people, false geography, or malformed focal objects are visible.
eval_history.targeted_fix: No further image pass needed. The deterministic furniture resolved the only pre-composition concern.
